title: Signed envelope
description: The signed unit of the protocol. additionalProperties is deliberately open: an unknown MINOR version may add optional fields, and a forwarder must preserve them so that forwarding never requires re-signing. Strictness lives in the payload schemas, which are closed.

protocol_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. An unknown MAJOR is rejected; an unknown MINOR is accepted.

event_id.description: UUIDv7 in canonical lowercase text form.

event_type.description: A registry type token. The permitted set is generated from registry.yaml and is deliberately not restated here: the registry is the only enumeration.

conductor_epoch.description: Fencing token. Present whenever source_conductor_id is.

sequence.description: Monotonic per signer. A gap is reported, never blocked on.

payload.description: Validated against the registry schema for event_type.

delegation_chain.description: delegation_id values, signer first, root-exclusive. Empty when the signer is a root. Maximum depth below a root is two.

signature.description: Ed25519 over the RFC 8785 canonical form of this object with signature omitted.
